name: Check Point Harmony Email & Collaboration
summary: Harmony Email & Collaboration is sold for Microsoft 365 and Gmail and includes anti-phishing, nickname impersonation checks and a quarantine workflow that can let users release suspected phishing. It comes in two packages, Advanced Protect and Complete Protect, priced by custom quote with a 14-day trial.

facts.text: Check Point claims 99.9% malware prevention and 99.7% phishing prevention. These are vendor figures we have not tested.
The anti-phishing engine detects phishing, suspected phishing and spam emails, and includes nickname impersonation detection for senders who mimic executive names.
A February 2023 Check Point post says administrators can let end users release Suspected Phishing emails without administrator approval.
Packages are Advanced Protect and Complete Protect, each offered as Email Only or Email & Collaboration, and Check Point offers a 14-day free trial.
